decisions.reason: It has been kept on its own website page from 2023 to 2024, indicating visible public commitment and invested development effort, so management is likely to continue and attribute any weak uptake to a still-maturing market.
As a 2024 launch with its own page, it is too new and too visibly backed for management to withdraw quickly, especially under a tendency to justify recent investment.

Although the website commitment is weaker because it is only mentioned rather than given its own page, it is still a very recent launch and management would usually give it more time before admitting failure.
